## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in San Miguel De Abona, Spain. It starts at 6 Calle Galicia.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Appreciate a spa experience that includes hot tubs, a relaxation pool, a toning pool, a Turkish bath, a shower temple, a foot soak, a pre-sauna Templarium, a traditional sauna, and a flotarium.
>
> The designated relaxation area provides a peaceful space to unwind. Furthermore, the spa's therapeutic water jets aim to ease everyday stresses and strains.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €44.85. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 18 ratings and 9 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
